audit_items.proof_trace: The POST /api/roles/sync-all endpoint (rolesSyncAll.ts:L216-222) returns { success, synced, failed, total, errors } — not roles_assigned or roles_removed. These fields belong to the per-member /api/roles/sync response type (RolesSyncResponse in types/api.ts), not the bulk endpoint. The consumer (syncAllDiscordRoles) only accesses result.synced/failed/total/errors and never reads roles_assigned or roles_removed, so no behavioral gap exists.
